name: Breakfast with Santa at Fox River Mall
venue: Northwoods Cafe at Fox River Mall
cost: $8 per ticket; children 2 and under free
paras: Fox River Mall in Appleton hosts its second annual Breakfast with Santa in the Northwoods Cafe on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 8:30 to 10 AM. Proceeds benefit Habitat for Humanity of the Greater Fox Cities.

Santa makes a grand entrance, and families get a breakfast from IHOP, coffee and cake pops from Starbucks, a visit from a princess, craft tables and one-on-one time with Santa. Tickets are $8 each and children 2 and under are free. Bring your proof of purchase.
tip: Buy tickets ahead and bring proof of purchase.

name: Pet Night with Santa at Fox River Mall
venue: Macy's Wing at Fox River Mall
when_note: Mondays and Tuesdays through December 15, 2026, 4 to 7 PM
cost: See the mall listing for photo pricing
paras: Pet Night with Santa runs on Monday and Tuesday evenings at Fox River Mall in Appleton, in the Macy's wing, from 4 to 7 PM. The remaining nights are November 30, December 1, 7, 8, 14 and 15, 2026.
Families bring their dogs and other pets for a photo with Santa, so the whole household can be in the holiday picture. Check the mall listing for each night and for photo package prices.
tip: Keep your pet leashed or in a carrier.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Beja Shrine Center
paras: The Beja Shriners welcome families to Breakfast with Santa at the Beja Shrine Center, 1950 Bond St. in Green Bay, on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 8:30 to 11 AM.
Tickets are $8 for adults and $5 for children ages 3 to 12, and children under 3 eat free. Families sit down for breakfast and visit with Santa.
tip: Arrive early to beat the late-morning crowd.

name: Sunday Brunch with Santa at The 1844 Table & Mash
address: Inside The Stella Hotel & Ballroom, downtown Kenosha, WI
when_note: Sundays, December 6 and 13, 2026, 9 AM to 2 PM
paras: The 1844 Table & Mash in downtown Kenosha serves a festive family brunch with a visit from Santa Claus on Sunday, December 6, and Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 9 AM to 2 PM.

The buffet has scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage, breakfast pizzas, pastries, fresh fruit and an omelet station, plus Grinch pancakes and a dessert station for kids. Adults are $24.95, kids 4 to 12 are $19.95 and kids under 3 are free. Reservations are required.
tip: Reserve early because it fills up.
